writeup: TIC 326225355 is an eclipsing binary star system newly discovered in archival data, absent from all six major variable-star catalogs checked. The system shows a primary eclipse that dims the star by 7.76% with an orbital period of 30.582605 days. A secondary eclipse was detected at high confidence, and automated pixel-level analysis confirmed the signal originates from the target star itself rather than a nearby object. The detection pipeline assigned this candidate a high reliability score of 0.97, reflecting the strength and consistency of the observations. With a signal-to-noise ratio of 1242.8 from the Box Least Squares analysis, this represents a robust discovery of a previously unknown binary star system.
